summary: The document notes that because WEPA is similar to NEPA, federally cleared projects are also considered state-cleared, but acknowledges that the Airport Spur nonetheless became subject to WEPA compliance because any project with potentially significant environmental effects must file a state EIS.
text:
Due to the similarity between the national and state law, all projects considered cleared under federal requirements will be considered cleared for the state also.
This document has been prepared to comply with provisions of both the state and federal environmental policy acts since it is written according to the federal guidelines and directives.
However, the guidelines developed for implementing the State Act in the spirit of the law also state that any project which may have significant effects on the environment is subject to the requirements for filing a state environmental impact statement.

The Airport Spur project therefore became applicable under compliance with the Wisconsin Environmental Policy Act even though it was an interim project which was federally and state exempt by date of design approval.
